description.en: Shows the standard "sysmes-Avatar-00001" avatar-attached message without actually attaching the avatar — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunAttachAvatarOnlyMsgUseMsg.
Character ID substituted into the message.
Avatar ID substituted into the message.
Optional; accepted for signature compatibility but has no effect since no attachment happens (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show the standard avatar-attached message without actually attaching it
RunAttachAvatarOnlyMsg("para_cp0009", "ck0003");
